title: Giza-wide model presented at the Malta conference

tellings.quote: Here is the model that they presented at the end of the Malta conference showing the entire Giza plateau and these underground vertical features connected into these cube features.

plain: At a conference in Malta in 2024, researchers presented a model of the whole Giza plateau in Egypt showing underground vertical features linked to cube-shaped features beneath the pyramids and the Sphinx, according to the researcher Jeffrey Drum. Drum describes the model, which he ties to the radar researcher Filippo Biondi. If the features are real, there would be a large hidden structure under the pyramids, which Drum's episode frames as an energy grid.
